argumentsArray: set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/kora; printf %s "$KORA_CONFIG_BASE64" | base64 -d > /tmp/kora/kora.original.toml; sed 's/^sign_transaction[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*false/sign_transaction = true/' /tmp/kora/kora.original.toml > /tmp/kora/kora.toml; grep -q "^sign_transaction = true" /tmp/kora/kora.toml; printf %s "$KORA_SIGNERS_BASE64" | base64 -d > /tmp/kora/signers.toml; exec kora --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --config /tmp/kora/kora.toml rpc start --signers-config /tmp/kora/signers.toml
